source.subject: jobs: add the jobs-control/1 control schema

findings.title: Lease TTL, heartbeat, worker CAS, and project scope are driver duties
findings.statement: A LOGIN member of oo_jobs_runtime committed a 24h lease, claimed a task whose run_at is seven days ahead, finished a live task by primary key with no lease_owner or generation predicate, replaced a live lease owner, and inserted an arbitrary project_id. Each statement then rolled back. The published contract places the 30s lease, 10s heartbeat, SKIP LOCKED claim loop, and worker CAS outside this schema. These results block AT-CTL-01 and AT-CTL-02. They match the schema-only contract.

findings.title: task_events.project_id is not bound to tasks.project_id
findings.statement: The runtime member inserted an event whose project_id is P2 for a task whose project_id is P1. The insert committed inside a transaction and was rolled back. Column privileges allow INSERT on every task_events column and forbid UPDATE. The contract says runtime insert is possible and does not claim tenant equality. A later audit that treats task_events as project-scoped needs a driver rule or a new constraint. Schedule occurrences do enforce same-project binding (23514).

findings.title: SQL stores the caller checksum; the reference shell must hash the release files
findings.statement: A direct apply that passed 64 hex ab bytes stored that lie, schema_version_present became true for jobs-control/1, and protocol_repeat with the real file hashes returned OO001 while the lie remained. A mutated contract JSON failed the host predicate with exit 3 before SQL. After a good apply, protocol_repeat with a zero digest returned OO001 and the stored hashes stayed the real file hashes. Ready is the conjunction of the version marker and an external file compare. A concurrent first apply while the lie held the advisory lock failed 42710 because oo_jobs_owner already existed.

findings.title: Runtime can hold the migration advisory lock
findings.statement: oo_a068_login selected pg_advisory_xact_lock(6401202601) inside a transaction. That blocks a migrator until the transaction ends. It does not grant schema ownership, DDL, or role admin. The same key serializes installers: a waiter with lock_timeout 2s received 55P03 while a holder slept.

findings.title: A superuser-planted SECURITY DEFINER keeps PUBLIC EXECUTE after ALTER OWNER
findings.statement: The fixture superuser created public.a068_adopt() SECURITY DEFINER, moved it into jobs, and set the owner to oo_jobs_owner. proacl stayed NULL, so PUBLIC EXECUTE remained. The runtime member executed it, the function reported current_user oo_jobs_owner, and it created schema a068_adopted_side. Cleanup dropped both. The runtime member cannot CREATE FUNCTION (42501) and cannot create this path. Functions created by oo_jobs_owner itself have public execute false and runtime execute true. Default privileges are global: a schema-only REVOKE left public execute true, and the global REVOKE left it false.
